selection: All five fresh-confirmation scenarios; four named controls; all worlds retained.
estimand: Equal-world mean of paired differences; differs from pooled per-contact means.
interval_method: 20,000 paired world bootstrap draws, 2.5/97.5 percentiles, PCG64 seed 202610180549.
limitations: Analysis chosen after seeing pilot summaries; not a new held-out confirmation.
Twelve world seeds per scenario; contacts/cells are not independent samples.
Intervals unadjusted across all reported comparisons; no familywise discovery claim.
Conditional on one selected rule and training procedure, not repeated independent training.
Fixed contact units and token accounting, not embodied Lenia or physical EU.
